description: The file defines a 'ScreenController' class responsible for managing a web view in an iOS application, handling URL navigation, web view snapshots, debug status updates, and the attachment/detachment of WKWebView instances. It provides mechanisms for working with deep links, A2UI actions, and trusted URLs within the app's web content environment.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class managing a web view, URL navigation, debugging, and state updates in an iOS application.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Handles navigation to a specified URL string, including validation and trust management.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the web view based on the current URL string and access control.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets the controller to display the default canvas loaded from internal resources.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display and applies the change.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the title and subtitle for debug status and applies the updates.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Calls a JavaScript function to update debug status in the web view if it's available.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Sets the JSON representing the home canvas state and updates the web view accordingly.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Executes JavaScript in the web view to render the home canvas state if applicable.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for A2UI to become ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript in the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Creates a PNG snapshot of the web view, encoded in Base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Creates a snapshot in either PNG or JPEG format, encoded in Base64 with optional quality setting.

methods.name: snapshotImage
methods.description: Captures a UIImage snapshot of the web view with optional maximum width.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Associates a WKWebView with the controller and initializes it.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches the current WKWebView if it matches the provided one.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted canvas UI URL.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Parses a body object from A2UI actions into a dictionary.
